subject: Nathan: pooled spend guards landed in your C2 files (8a07d0b)
body: Nathan is running the pilot himself and told me to make spend safe across the team's credits, so I edited your locked files: harness/tinker_proxy.py (Pool of Tinker accounts, each with a lifetime $ budget in ~/.autoresearch ledgers; per-run cap; worst-case reservation before sampling; max_tokens clamp 16384; --list-models; refuses to start without a limit), scripts/c2_pilot.sh (preflight step, per-step TINKER_RUN_USD + MAX_MINUTES watchdog, Modal workspace pick via new scripts/modal_pool.py, TINKER_MODEL override), RUN_PILOT.md spend section. Tests: tests/test_tinker_budget.py, tests/test_modal_pool.py, harness pooled end-to-end test; 641 main + 10 harness OK. Heads-up: Tinker's pricing page no longer lists Kimi K2.5 and its deprecation page names K2.6 as replacement; tinker_cookbook 0.6.1 has a kimi_k26 renderer. Default stays K2.5 pending preflight. Please pull before editing these files.
